headline: Soluna repays $28.7 million in debt, reducing principal by 76%
summary: Soluna repaid $28.7 million in debt, reducing its total principal balance by 76%.
why: Debt reduction lowers interest expense burdens and improves balance sheet stability for growth-stage technology or infrastructure firms.
